requirement_text.ISS-0332: REQ-077 bumped the DEFINITION_PROMOTED platform-event-type seed from schema_version 1 (review_id required non-null) to schema_version 2 (review_id nullable) in lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex. This seed only applies to newly provisioned tenants. Pre-existing tenants' event_type_registry still has v1. R10 against such a tenant commits the promotion transaction, then fails the event-append step on schema validation -- Severity-1 broken-audit shape. Needs a backfill routine.

task.description:
Validate CODE-DESIGNER's design artefact at lib/letflow/design/iss0332-definition-promoted-backfill.md (on branch feature/WF03-ISS0332-20260826). Check out that branch before reading the file.

Validation criteria:
1. Every ISS-0332 acceptance criterion is explicitly mapped to a design element (AC1: backfill updates pre-existing tenants; AC2: R10 succeeds end-to-end; AC3: idempotent on already-v2 tenants).
2. Scope decision (backfill only vs structural fix) is stated with rationale.
3. Backfill module/function name and @spec are stated -- no implementation code present.
4. All register_type/2 return value cases are addressed (ok, duplicate_event_type_version, schema_version_not_monotonic, tenant_not_provisioned, other).
5. The design is unambiguous enough for ELIXIR-DEV to implement without making new design decisions.
6. No implementation code in the design doc (function bodies, actual Elixir code, etc.).

If PASS: complete handoff with status PASS and next_action 'ORCH routes to ELIXIR-DEV for implementation'.
If FAIL: list specific issues; ORCH will rework with CODE-DESIGNER.
acceptance_criteria: All six validation criteria checked against the actual design doc
PASS verdict only if all six criteria are met
FAIL verdict with specific issues if any criterion fails
